snippet.title: Galaxy gameplay (PC Game, 1981)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Galaxy, Dos PC game produced by Avalon Hill in 1981 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/galaxy/16564/
Galaxy is a pretty nice adventure game based on the text. This game is made in the early 80 'and deserves to play.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
